card.name: Words leading into dose amounts
card.fires_on: Small linking words just before a dose amount or frequency, such as "up to", "in", "at a", "between" and "three" (times a day), in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Increase limits
modes.description: Words like "to" after "up" that introduce a maximum dose or step size.
modes.example: Increase the dosage in increments of up<< to>> 75 mg per day, as

modes.label: Frequency and schedule
modes.description: Words just before how often or how many times a dose is given.
modes.example: Start 150 mg<< three>> times a day orally, with or without

modes.label: Starting or stepping dose
modes.description: Words that introduce a starting dose or a stepwise change in dose.
modes.example: the drug should be reintroduced cautiously by starting<< with>> a lower dosage and increasing slowly.

card.plain: It fires on the small words that come right before a dose number or how often to give it.
